items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change matches the reference: one call, `self.query.get_initial_alias()`, plus a short comment, `# Ensure base table is in aliases.`, written in the same style as the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing helper `query.get_initial_alias()` in a two-line edit to single_alias. No duplicated logic, dead code or debug output, and Collector/QuerySet.delete are left alone.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No error handling is needed for this change. It is idempotent: get_initial_alias returns the existing alias if one is already registered. There are no magic constants or swallowed errors.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias, so the MySQL override benefits too. The agent's check shows `ALL: DELETE FROM "delete_user"` while the JOIN delete still uses the `IN (SELECT U0."id" ... INNER JOIN ...)` subquery. Hidden tests pass: F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52.
